'''Begas Tok''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|Male]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Entralla/Legends|Entralla]].

==Biography==
Begas Tok was active on [[Entralla/Legends|Entralla]] and the [[Velcar Free Commerce Zone]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

In the years following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Tok bought [[Zipthar hexa-crystal]]s from the [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] [[Reina Gale]] and [[Rollos]] in order to sell them in the sector and make a considerable return on his investment.<ref name="AJ4" />

However, the deal was interrupted by the intervention of the [[Pentastar Patrol]]. In fact Tok betrayed the smugglers to the police. He planned to recover both the crystals and the [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. Tok wasn't worried about the police because he was permitted to conduct trade in hexa-crystals.<ref name="AJ4" />

==Personality and traits==
Begas Tok had a wheezing style of speech.
